notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34132006/824c61aea413d51aaaf593314992616cf8863aa7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34132006/63dd683b3280e41e93ad890ccb7e891d80860293.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Update notes[/h1]
[b]Duplicates Artifacts on Black Market Bugfix [/b]- we have fixed a minor bug with duplicates on black market demand. If an artefact is demanded, you can sell all duplicates of that artifact on demand (without risk). The limit of this operation wasn't a bug, but if the player had more than 1 demanded artefact the interface of the game didn't behave as intended.
[b]Spelling Fix [/b]- The horrendous 'stroy' instead of 'story' in press relations report is fixed, just like a few more minor spellings.
[b]Testers Console Unlocked[/b] - We decided to unlock a small tool designed for testers. To enter the testers' console use Left CTRL + F9. Keep in mind that you can create malfunction of the game client using this console, it's recommended to not using it if you worry about your current save.

[h1]Summary[/h1]
This late update is our 'quick' response to the last bug report (Duplicates on the Black Market). However, we have prepared some spellings fixes some time ago, and decided to (more than 1 year after the full release) unlock the testers' console for you.

[b]Cheers![/b]
Artists Entertainment

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.06[/h1]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34132006/824c61aea413d51aaaf593314992616cf8863aa7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34132006/63dd683b3280e41e93ad890ccb7e891d80860293.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Update note[/b]
[b]Spelling fixes[/b] - we have fixed a few spellings (Press Bio, the letter with expedition reward)
[b]Font size in Press Bio and Opponents Bio[/b] - The font is bigger now
[b]Recompense for a strike[/b] - We've changed recompense for a strike. Now it's 3000 Pounds on Easy and 1000 Pounds on Normal.
[b]Crashing bug fix[/b] - There was a bug causing crashes on some devices. It should be patched now but we are going to keep an eye on the problem. Devices with low RAM (less than 2 GB RAM) can be still vulnerable.
[b]Starting Funds in Custom[/b] - We've added an option which allows changing the starting funds for the players in custom games from 0 to 20 000 Pounds.
[b]Highlighted information in Press Bio[/b] - The information about preferable stimulant in the Press Bio is now in italics.
[b]The bug on first career letter fix[/b] - On some devices, there was a bug messing the first letter in the career from Francisco. It was hard to trace because it didn't appear on the second or next time.
[b]Menu window for Custom and Career updated[/b] - new UI design.


[b]Summary[/b]
We have traced some bugs which were reported some time ago. We managed to fix them but we are going to keep watching the reports because there can be always more to it. We also wanted to add more options to the local coop custom games, which we did, but only on a micro-scale (aka starting funds).
What are we going to update next? We see that a lot of you struggle with the game (which is ok for us but is not ok for the sales). We are running some test for a new solution to these problems. Hard and Dreadful difficulty won't be affected.
We also want more customization, like the starting funds but in a more creative way.
And yes, we are still working on the spellings and texts, but we are not focused on that at the moment.

We would like to thank you for this year (it's almost a full year for us, we entered the Early Access on 17.01.2019), your support was heartwarming and helpful! We will keep working on improvements in the future. What's more? We are working on our unannounced which we hope to share with you soon!

We would want to especially thank YouTubers, streamers, influencers and people talking about our game for your time and effort! Without you, there would be no Archeo: Shinar in the first place! What a year for games, what a year for archeology, what a year for us! Thank You.

Sincerely
Artists Entertainment

[b]Spelling fixes[/b] - we have fixed a few spellings (the " after 'moderate')
[b]The required explorers' glitch [/b]- The game sometimes didn't want to show the number of required explorers, now it's fixed.
[b]Tutorials[/b] - From now on the player doesn't need to finish career missions to unlock new tutorials.

[b]Summary[/b]
The locked tutorials were a thing in the game to force players to play and learn in a flow, but it's clear that the game isn't easy and significant number of players would like to spend some time in the tutorials before playing real games. Same for local multiplayer. We admit that locking the tutorials behind the career progression was a mistake. It doesn't cost us much work to unlock them, but it cost us a lot of time to talk it through. We asked a question like why should we force players to jump in the game after the first tutorial, what about players who don't want to play career and what if the player is going to spend his first 1 hours of the game in the tutorials. The answer? Unlocked tutorials.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.03[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34132006/a2c6f7621e2242abe5150e7e594bb6e1bd4cee2a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34132006/0b3a78da17128247e8c4bfd944071db199f55b36.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Update note[/b]
[b]Spelling fixes[/b] - we have fixed a few spelling (the unicorn in the explorer's bio for example)
[b]Optimization [/b]- We have optimized a few things in the code to make the game run better
[b]Cheat[/b] - We have added a cheat. Yes, a cheat. You can acquire money from your family funds just by inputting 'familyfunds' in the game. However, it works only on EASY. You can find a hint about that in the Archeopedia.

[b]Bugs[/b]
Currently, Archeo: Shinar uses the Unity game engine's DirectX 11 renderer. However, on a small number of systems we've found it can be less stable and sometimes cause crashes (or frame drops) for some users.
You can use the steps below to force DirectX 9 mode, which might potentially improve stability for you, at the potential cost of image quality and performance issues. This solution worked for all of our study cases.
Steam
Go to your Steam Library
Find Archeo: Shinar and right-click it, then select "Properties"
Under the General Tab, click "Set Launch Options" and a dialogue box will appear
Type in "-force-d3d9" (without the quotes) and click "OK"
Close the Properties window
Enjoy the game
At the moment, we can not simply fix the bug because it's in the engine, not in the game. We will study it further, but it occurs only on specific setups and the fix worked perfectly for all of the studied cases.

[b]Summary[/b]
We have seen that a lot of players struggle to finish the game, even on easy. That's why we decided to add a simple cheat. We have tested the cheat and put a limit on it (you can't get more than 100k money using it in a single play) to make sure everything is stable (AI sanity especially). This should not only make it easier to finish the game just for the story but also allows to change starting conditions (or to give an advantage to someone) during local multiplayer (custom games). For now, it's just a simple cheat, but we want more than that, we want to allow players to customize custom games even more. However, in our industry, and in life, one needs resources to realize goals. It will take some time to deliver more advanced updates. We are here, working for all of our supporters, on Archeo and also on an unannounced project. With this little update, we wanted to present a fix to the DirectX bug and force a simple cheat allowing you to mess with the game.

Cheers!

notes.title: More about the voice over
notes.content:
[h1]More about the voice over[/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/c3674f477b7bc8ea97e20f91f3f5460aac97477c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/70d6c84769102a9786b046bb534cb8f59cbedce1.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]How many voice actors?[/b]
We have 8 voice actors. Every one of them represents a different character or a different subject. We wanted to have one voice for one character and we managed to arrange that.

[b]Where to find voice over in the game?[/b]
First of all, all the plot-relevant letters and events have voice over. This means that also all animated clips have voice over too. We don't have voice over for standard random events or the standard expeditions, but if it's a part of the plot, you may be sure it will have voice over. But what about the tutorial?
We decided to add voice over to the tutorial, all 5 parts of the tutorial have full voice-over. No need to read Cuppy's text bubbles anymore!

[b]How long is the full voice-over?[/b]
There's no simple answer to that. We have about 1 hour of voice over relevant to the plot. Plus the tutorial. Usually, the player will listen to 0,5 - 3 minutes tracks, during the animated clip or in a letter from the opponent.

[b]Who are the voice actors?[/b]
We tried to find the best fit for our characters. This means that Lennox's voice should be British, Roztopchin's voice should be Russian and Vanessa's voice should be French. We have a British actor for Lennox, a Russian actor for Roztopchin and a French actress for Vanessa. All of the actors are professional voice actors. We needed to pick not only actors with certain native language but also fluent in English to deliver you the best experience.

[b]How much longer do we have to wait for the full release?[/b]
The full release will be sooner than you think. The sound effects are ready, we are polishing the game, synchronizing new assets (voices and sound effects), testing, testing and testing various features.

notes.title: New easy difficulty
notes.content:
[h1]New easy difficulty[/h1]
What is going to change on easy difficulty? As you may know, we've created a special difficulty for players focused on messing around and/or the story. In the full game, there are going to be 4 different options for difficulty, when for now in early access you can only experience 3 of them.
Let us introduce Easy difficulty!

But why is it different? Because it's not based on balancing numbers without changing anything in the game. With this option, the player will enable new features, which will make the game easier than ever before.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/472fd57a743f60c19eaa4fc892bb7cc539661e04.png[/img]

[b]1. Friendly Institute[/b]
The Institute is going to help player after first and the second strike. How? With money! When you are struggling to pay off you explorers, the Institute will help you by sending you more money! Isn't that wonderful? Just don't spend it on Gin, ok?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/c6b79654b508e24f8a51f2c7d4e3fd4ef250323d.png[/img]

[b]2. Honest Explorers[/b]
The explorers will tell you if there's no chance for them to succeed in a random quest. This should help you choose the right ones to the task. However, this feature works only for random quests plus.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/74ae624167b340b5e270e16463e6ded1cd1ff830.png[/img]

[b]3. Time is irrelevant[/b]
Do you know that with every second delay on random quests they are getting harder and harder? No? Now you know. But don't worry, on easy difficulty, there's no delay, just take your time and pick your best explorers. But don't wait too long, you still have the time limit!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/dc483166f97ef2afe97efce5f7b0c6e518d2a096.png[/img]
[b]
4. Childish opponents[/b]
Maybe, just maybe, your opponents aren't the sharpest tools in the shed. Their reputation will grow slower, their decisions are going to be... questionable. But hey! This way you will have more time for Cuppy. And guess who have prepared 129 new songs for karaoke night? Yes, you are right! It's Robert Mond!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/374b1d329f2dfe78685c11d12b04829527c130e4.png[/img]
[b]
5. Expedition Difficulty Description[/b]
Every expedition is going to have a description telling the player how hard it is. No more evaluation of the risk, no more overpreparing, we are going to tell you if it will be hard. Just do you best and try to estimate what 'hard' means in the terms of your explorers' skills.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/5aa2f1eaf6060055fed4defd2d55cb2cef6b9695.png[/img]

[b]6. Greenhorn Landlords[/b]
Who knows how to participate in a land auction? I know who don't know - your opponents. They are going to be very safe and won't risk too much on the land auctions. If you want to buy land, then just buy the bloody land. Who would stop you? General Knabl with his penny offer? 

We hope the easy mode will allow you to experience Archeo: Shinar in a different way. We don't want to punish people for not wanting to struggle with the economy of this world. If you are here just for the story (or for your own reasons, like establishing communism once and for all) then who are we to judge? You want easy. Here's easy. Well... It's not 'here', but it will be in the full version of the game.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update #05 Note (0.88a)
notes.content:
[h1]Update #05 Note (0.88a)[/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/3a4ca94e7470de7f4aa89385c8d9e3dd62866b22.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/64dbd03ee47eb733c1300980e2fbe0af03b7e635.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[b]New Achievements[/b]
[i]Commentary: We actually prepared not only those few achievements that are presented in this update but also 10 more, which are hidden for now, because they are in relation with the career mode.[/i]
[b]GOG Achievements[/b]
[i]Commentary: The same ones like on Steam, but on GOG.[/i]
[b]Merchant Company - Indicators on the chart[/b]
[i]Commentary: We wanted the player to know when and how much was bought in a certain round of certain stimulant.[/i]
[b]Letters - Send Button with the price[/b]
[b]Black Market - Information on hover about risk and margin[/b]
[i]Commentary: It’s different for buying and selling.[/i]
[b]Indicator for an unspent exclusive license for press[/b]
[b]The Chess Club indicator for the closed club[/b]
[b]Visual effects for the button in the whole game[/b]
[b]Transition effect between the main menu and game/tutorial[/b]
[b]New Screenshots on the game page[/b]
[b]Minor UI alterations[/b]
[i]Commentary: For example, the panels with Lobby, Expeditions or Quarters react on hover mouse.[/i]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Explorers’ Training[/b]
[i]Commentary: The training is back, we are sorry to keep you with this bug for so long.[/i]
[b]Black Market Demand[/b]
[i]Commentary: It’s a bug when on the black market you can find the same artifact on Demand and For Sale.[/i]
[b]Land Auction Schedule[/b]
[i]Commentary: There was a silly mistake, which limited checking the schedule to 1 check per round. This odd limit was terminated.[/i]
[b]Chief Editor’s catchphrases[/b]
[i]Commentary: Ok, their catchphrases aren’t the bug itself. However, we didn’t want the player to refresh the Chess Club only to get another catchphrase. Every editor is going to have one catchphrase per round. [/i]
[b]Flavour texts grammar fix[/b]
[b]Random Event ‘The Alpinist’ fix[/b]
[i]Commentary: There was a bug in its conditions. It wasn’t a game crashing bug, but it didn’t work as intended. We have fixed its conditions on which it happens, you won’t even see the difference in the game. It took us 2 or 3 days to find this bug, determine the problem and find the right solution, but don’t worry, nobody will ever notice that we have fixed it. But we did.[/i]
[b]A bunch of bugs in Tutorial caused by us messing around with the career mode[/b]
[i]Commentary: After working on the user interface in the career mode (especially the assets system) we have messed up a lot in the tutorials. We had to relocate some objects on the interface, make a place for more options and add some hovers, which made the tutorial mad. But it’s all good for now.[/i]
[b]Flavour text - it’s always Greece[/b]
[i]Commentary: The idea is that Flavour Texts, Random Events, the color on the globe and the found artifacts should be all from the same group, for example, from Greece. However, it happened that all flavour texts were always from Greece. What’s even more interesting, this bug didn’t occur in the 0.83a build, and we are talking about it just for your amusement.[/i]
[b]A motherload of bugs in Career mode[/b]
[b]Commentary: Yes, we did that, but you won’t tell, because the Career isn’t available yet.[/b]
[b]Wrong graphic design for Share your story (Press tab)[/b]
[i]Commentary: In fact, we didn’t fix it, we just made a step back, because the new graphic design is being fixed and we used our temporary graphic for that pop-up. It’s like we made two steps forward, but the second one was bad, so we made one step back and from your perspective, we did one step forward, which is nice and if you hadn’t read this commentary you would assume that it’s a progress.[/i]
[b]A lot of minor text corrections[/b]
[b]Gifts in the relation’s reports[/b]
[i]Commentary: There was a bug which didn’t show the true impact of the correct gifts for the particular press relations. The math worked good, but the reports contained a bug, it’s fixed now.[/i]

[h1]Summary[/h1]
	It’s probably our smallest update, or at least we feel like it’s the smallest update because we did so much more in last month, but we can’t show it to you yet, because we were working on the career mode. There was a lot of testing for us, adjustments and preparing structures for new animation clips and sounds. We have been debugging our game just to place new bugs in it a few days later. It was a rough month for our development team, but our effort won’t be seen in the current build. In fact, this is the last update before the full release. We plan to exit the early access and we would love to do so in 6 to 8 weeks from now, but there’s still a lot to do. We have currently 32 tasks on our board and we are completing them one by one.
	With this update, we also launch a week sale on Steam (20% off) and it is also the last sale before the full release. We don’t want to tell you that it’s the best time to buy our game, but it’s the best time to buy our game if you don’t want to wait for the full release. 
	We are excited and thrilled because we are closer to the full release with every day of our work. But with the excitement there’s also a lot of stress, the pressure is on, we hope that you, the players will like out career mode, we don’t want to disappoint you and we are doing our best to deliver you the best quality. We know (and you should know it too by now) that Archeo: Shinar won’t be AAA game, but in our hearts, it’s not just a little indie game, it’s our little big adventure and we are going to give our best to polish it.
	During the early access, we have heard a lot of criticism, which wasn’t always constructive, but there were also words of support. And we are going on and on thanks to your kindness and patience. We love to see you playing Archeo, we scream when we see that you're doing something wrong and we smile when you achieve new goals in our game. It’s been a wonderful 5 months in this early access, but we don’t want to stay here for longer than it’s necessary. The money is tight, but the money is always tight and we don’t take it as an excuse.
	Before the full release, we are going to present to you a new gameplay trailer (the old one is from the un-updated game, which doesn’t show a lot of features) and the story trailer. We hope you are thrilled just like us and can’t wait for the full release. We have that big twist prepared for you in the career mode, and it’s harder and harder for us to stay quiet for us.
	What’s also interesting is that we are going to announce a new project. We are still busy with Archeo: Shinar, and we didn’t have a lot of time to work on it, but we think that a few weeks after the full release you can expect this announcement. And don’t worry, we won’t go back to the super hardcore arcade games like Zquirrels Jump, our next project will be developed by us (no second developer or publisher to interfere) and you should expect unexpected! Hope you like new changes (yes, we know, it’s more like bug fixes than changes or new features) and we can’t wait for the full release.
	To sum it up, it’s the last update before full release, it’s the last discount before full release and we will have 2 new trailers for you in the next weeks (probably closer to the full release).


Cheers!

notes.title: Updates, Release Date and Discounts
notes.content:
[h1]Updates, Release Date and Discounts[/h1]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/c3674f477b7bc8ea97e20f91f3f5460aac97477c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/70d6c84769102a9786b046bb534cb8f59cbedce1.jpg[/img][/url]

Hi everyone, we have a few news about Archeo: Shinar for you today. It’s not a clear statement but an attempt to keep you up to date.
Firstly, the release date. As you may know, we decided to add more animation clips to the story, delayed work with voice actors and ran a few tests. When we entered the early access we wanted to release the full project in June, the second half of June to be precise. However, now we see that we need more time due to the story polishing and for more tests. The game code is stable (yes, we know about those little bugs, we are working on it, but they keep appearing when we are messing with the career mode), the game (mainly the interface) still needs more love, but our main concern is the story. At this point (as stated before, due to unknown factors like voice actors time of delivery) we can’t give you a firm date, but the idea is to let you know what’s going on in our studio. We want to release Archeo: Shinar in the second half of July or the first half of August.
Secondly, updates. There will be one more update in June, it will be minor update with UI changes and bug fixes. We want to keep those last weeks in early access to work on the career mode and deliver you as big update as possible on the release day.
And the discounting. Ok, the very important thing about this is the game price. We decided to not modify it. The game on the release will cost $12,99, as it is now. Why? Because we don’t need to alter it, we don’t have an investor pushing us to do so, we are developing and publishing this game on our own (with our own money and willpower to do so) and we feel that it’s a good price.
But what about discounting? Yes, there will be discounts after the full release, but, we want discounts to be a small fraction of the full price. In years the discount will rise, but to get Archeo: Shinar for 50% of the price one will have to wait. And by the wait, we mean to be really patient, because we are not going to change our mind after a few months and place -60% discount on this game. The discounts will be a regular thing after the premiere, however, you can be sure that the price won’t drop just like that in a day. We see a lot of such practice on the market and we don’t want it for our game. Archeo: Shinar has its own value and the stable price should confirm that. We would rather give a game for free than discount it 90% off (In fact we just did, with our second game, Zquirrels Jump) in its first year on the market.
There also will be the last discount on Steam during the early access in June, we can’t tell you when exactly, but in June. After that, we do not plan to create discounts until the full release. 

Cheers!

notes.title: Update #04 Note (0.83a)
notes.content:
[h1]Update #04 Note (0.83a)[/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/3a4ca94e7470de7f4aa89385c8d9e3dd62866b22.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/64dbd03ee47eb733c1300980e2fbe0af03b7e635.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]
Changes[/h1]
[b]Cuppy Tips[/b]
[i]Commentary: From now on Cuppy will have some random tips to say. We have prepared 20 of those for you. Maybe it will be a good reason for you to not turn her off.[/i]
[b]Tutorial IV[/b]
[i]Commentary: After all, we decided to limit it (it won’t take more than 3 minutes) and trust that you, the player can use the knowledge and find a way to use it in practice. We were on the edge with the 4th tutorial because the new players won’t get any ideas how to use Black Market in an optimal way. Nevertheless, we decided to leave it without comments and suggestion about the player’s tactic. We feel that even without a good idea how to use Black Market player can still enjoy the game and win on easier difficulties, even if this feature is required to win the game on the harder difficulties.[/i]
[b]Random Events - Old Letters[/b]
[i]Commentary: The option to open old letter when a random event is linked to an older one event was always there, but we decided to place it in a better place, as a third option under the letter.[/i]
[b]Press Favours - Hover with description[/b]
[i]Commentary: Have you ever wanted to know what that thing for 5 favours does? Now you can just hover your mouse over it and see the tip.[/i]
[b]Random Quests, Boosters Descriptions, Opponents’ Bios and more text corrections.[/b]
[b]Institute Portrait in letters from the Institute in Custom Game[/b]
[b]30 new names for the explorers[/b]
[i]Commentary: We tried to add more names from Europe, like from Netherlands or the Czech Republic.[/i]
[b]Legendary Explorers - Skills depending on their story[/b]
[i]Commentary: We don’t want to make you believe that John Dillinger is a great Geologist. Their basic skill set from now on will try to stick to their personalities and history. Player still will be able to teach them whatever he (or she) wants.[/i]
[b]Player’s Delay in Reports for Hard and Dreadful difficulty[/b]
[i]Commentary: The player delay is an important factor and can change the outcome of an expedition. From now on the data will be shown in the reports. The Normal difficulty doesn’t have such a feat, because player’s delay doesn’t affect gameplay mechanics on this difficulty. Of course, you still can lose a random quest due to the time, but it doesn’t matter if you spend 20 or 25 seconds deciding who should do the thing. On Hard (and Dreadful) those seconds counts and the more you wait the harder the task will be.[/i]
[b]Flavour Texts[/b]
[i]Commentary: Yes, it is here. From now on every standard expedition will have 3 flavour texts. Every flavour text is linked to the place of the expedition and the third one will always be more specific about the course of events. Hovering over the flavour text will slow down the time and the flavour texts will appear in the reports. We have prepared 270 flavour texts for you. 90 per destination.
[/i]

[h1]Summary[/h1]
	We are currently postponing the work with the voice actors due to the changes to the story. We have a lot of little bugs between the last update and this update because we need to change some things n the game structure. The tutorial V is also ready for you but we have hidden it because we feel that information may ruin your first experience with the game (we don’t want new players to start their experience with all 5 tutorials when after the full release the tutorials will be unlocked during the career).
	We are running some tests focused on the story part of the game and it looks like it will take us more time than expected to find the sweet spot between the fun and the actual story. Originally the story was way too focused on facts and it used some concepts from the field of archeology and geology which don’t have to be known to everybody. We don’t want to give you a lesson on the topic about sediments or cartography, because that’s not the point, but also we don’t want to use deus ex machina solutions. We decided to change some plot twists and place them in alternatives. Yes, alternatives. After all, we needed to place alternative approach in one mission to keep things interesting for casual players, but also to leave something for the hardcore players (the ones who play the game to translate ancient documents and don’t mind spending time in libraries and analyzing some old writings).
	At some point, we fund the story to become a little bit goofy, because we added a few choices which are not good examples how archeology works, but after a few tests, we have limited the amount of those actions. We believe we are close to the sweet spot to keep things interesting but also don’t push it too much. We still need more time to implement the animation clips (and wait for our animator to finish them) and test the whole story.
	We also worked on the assets system, which allows the player to use supplies (and explorers) from last missions in the next ones. We needed to limit it at some point (like for legendary explorers) but it works just fine now. It has also caused a few minor bugs, but it’s all fixed now. But again, you won’t see this system till the full release.
	We hope you understand that it takes time to polish the story. Have some fun with the new flavour texts and say hello to Cuppy!

Cheers!

notes.title: What are we currently working on? - A few words about coming changes
notes.content:
[h1]What are we currently working on? - A few words about coming changes[/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/4ad0248bd1e188a2fccce32399e8a5f7ef1b180d.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/a4e18b62405a51ea1070729f20aafe58ca98c219.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Tutorials[/b]
	As you know there are 2 more tutorials being produced. One of them won’t be here till the full release. We decided to limit them and trust you, the player to use the knowledge and find a way to use it in practice. We were on the edge with the 4th tutorial because the new players won’t get any ideas on how to use Black Market in an optimal way. Nevertheless, we decided to leave it without comments and suggestion about the player’s tactic. We feel that even without a good idea how to use Black Market player can still enjoy the game and win on easier difficulties, even if this feature is required to win the game on the harder difficulties.
	Same with 5th, we tried to show different paths for the player, but after all decided to deliver only information about more advanced game rules and a few observations, which can help the player to better understand if the current strategy is a good or bad one in the long term.
	This way the tutorial won’t teach anybody how to win and its goal is only to present the rules and show the player how certain mechanics works, without telling if something is a good or a bad thing to do. We believe that the learning curve won’t be too long for the new players to make them confused or annoyed because each tutorial will be introduced after certain missions in the career mode. This also means that the first missions in the career mode may be a little bit too easy for the players who spend some time with Archeo, like more than 5 hours.

[b]Career Narrative[/b]
	Yes, the career story and narrative. The first impressions weren’t good, we needed to scrap it and assemble it again. The quality assurance flagged the story as the weak spot for the game and we decided to delay the voice over to polish the narrative. Due to the QA statement, we decided to test the story on a closed group of testers, which wasn’t easy because not all parts of it were implemented, but after all, we received some feedback. Our main problem is that the story isn’t clear enough, especially for people who don’t have knowledge in the field of history and archeology. What’s more, testers felt that the story lacks a good transition between missions.
	To address those problems we rebuild the story, maybe not from the beginning, but we tried to make it more clear and easy to understand. The main change is 5 new animation clips, which will appear before each mission. We also merged ending with epilog to capture the essence and cut the unnecessary transition time (and confusion, because the ending did not answer a crucial question). Those changes for sure will extend the time period before the release, but that’s the price of the quality.
	And the opponents will talk less during the career mode. We decided to capture their personalities in a few personal letters to the player and merged it with informative letters to spare the player void words without any impact on the actual game. The digressions will appear only in letters between career missions in order to keep the player focused on the current task. We also limited Institution presence in the story, we are going to reference it very often, but it won’t be an active interlocutor. This way we will give you a more condensed story, fewer digressions and more space for the gameplay.

[b]Career Assets System[/b]
	This system will allow the player to take something from one mission and use it in the second one. We are polishing it and testing its impact on the gameplay. It’s a really straight forward process, but we need to set some limitations, like that the player can’t take legendary explorers. The system is easy to understand and similar to the equipping explorers before the expedition, but in this case, the player is equipping the main character with explorers before the mission. But we don’t want to stop on explorers, we want more options, like lands or cash.

[b]Text correction and minor adjustments[/b]
	We’re still working on text correction and more. Actually, most of those adjustments will be released in the next update in May. We’ve added 20 tips to the base of Cuppy commentary to help players better understand the game. And we certainly don’t want to give you a reason to turn Cuppy commentary on again. The legendary explorer’s specialization will be correlated with his life story (John Dillinger wasn’t a geologist, and it’s rather funny to see him with 100 Geology and 20 in Combat Capability. However, it’s funny only for the first time, but later on, it becomes a little bit annoying. Well… according to our lead game designer, it’s super annoying, but we can’t quote him on that because he used mean words to flag this problem).
	There’s also a minor bug with the forecasts, the player can open the forecast’s tab only once per round now, it’s obviously a bug and it will be fixed too.

[b]The flavour texts[/b]
	We won’t discuss this topic here, if you want to learn more about that you can find it here -> [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1001980/announcements/detail/1644286650950413809][/url]
and here -> [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1001980/announcements/detail/1778267476141211162][/url]

Flavour texts in a nutshell - There will be 3 texts for each standard expeditions, but we are still working on it, because we want them to make sense and don’t contradict anything, like the random events in the letters after the expeditions.

Cheers!

notes.title: The Expeditions - Flavour texts versus Career Expeditions
notes.content:
[h1]The Expeditions - Flavour text versus Career Expeditions[/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/c3674f477b7bc8ea97e20f91f3f5460aac97477c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/70d6c84769102a9786b046bb534cb8f59cbedce1.jpg[/img][/url]

As you may know, we are working on an additional text for the expeditions, because as many of you have mentioned, the expeditions lack some spicy story or at least some description of what’s going on. And yes, we are working on the flavour texts but you should know that the career expeditions and standard expeditions are different structures. Playing career mode the player’s going to experience a few career expeditions, but the standard expeditions still will be the most common thing to do in the game. And the flavour text designed for standard expeditions won’t affect career expeditions. Why?

[b]Career Expeditions[/b]
During career expeditions, the player will find a few events (presented as a text) with a choice. That choice will affect gameplay, it may change the required skill in the upcoming random quest (which isn’t random anymore, if the player decides what to do) or it can change its difficulty. The career expeditions are story-driven, those events are linked and every career expedition has a clear goal. If it’s based on linguistics, then the goal is probably to translate something, the events will describe problems and the player is going to choose the solution. However, the standard expeditions don’t have, and won’t have such an advanced narrative. In fact, the career expeditions are on the edge, if the player can predict how the decision can alter the next random quest the game become a little unbalanced. We applied a few solutions to the career expeditions to make sure that it won’t destroy the gameplay even if the player knows all of the choices and knows how to alter each event. This is why the number of career expeditions must have been limited. If all of the expeditions would allow the player such a choice, then the player won’t choose by the beliefs in the heart, because the choices would be defined by the player’s team of explorers. And in the end, the story would lose its own value. And we want the career expeditions to contain a valuable story, but with meaningful choices.

[b]Standard Expeditions[/b]
The standard expeditions will have 3 flavour texts for each expedition. Those texts won’t affect the gameplay, they are here only for immersion and better ex[erience. The standard flavour texts (texts prepared for standard expeditions, which don’t appear during career expeditions) are divided into 2 groups. First 2 texts on each expedition will be always from the first group. Those are shorter texts about events during the expedition. For example ‘Your team was accused of grave robbing but a small bribe resolved that problem.’. The third text is from the second group, which means that it can be longer, but it also can tell us more why the expedition could go wrong or why it was a success. The third flavour text appears always after the last random quest. Another example? ‘Your team got lost somewhere in the Kunlun mountains. Fortunately, they were found and escorted back by a strange group of 8 old men. They told a few disturbing stories, which one was about the Bohai Sea. But are they a credible source?’. Those texts won’t change your fate, if the expedition is lost then it’s lost, but should be a fine addition to the game. What’s more, flavour texts for standard expeditions adapt to the location. Presented examples can’t appear during the expedition in Egypt, because they wouldn’t have any sense. Kunlun mountains and the Chinese legend of 8 immortals don’t have anything in common with Egypt. This way, depending on where the expedition is placed not only artifacts and the random event after the expedition will vary but also the flavour texts are designed specifically for the region. One may wonder if the first group of the standard flavour texts is also designed this way, and the answer is yes. For example, let’s say that a flavour text states that an explorer had a dream. Depending on the location the dream can be different. In Egypt, one can dream about biblical 7 fat cows and 7 gaunt ones, when in Greece the dream would be about giving birth to a living torch, which burnt a city to the ground. The standard flavour texts can contain some trivia about local history, mythology, and culture or could focus on your team and their personal adventures. The main goal for the standard flavour texts is to make the game more immersive. The standard flavour texts will appear during the expeditions on the map (the player will need to hover the mouse above them to read them) and in the expedition report.

[b]Will the career expeditions have voice over?[/b]
Yes, the career expeditions will have voice over for the events.

[b]The expeditions are restricted by time, will it stop for the flavour texts?[/b]
It won’t be stopped for the standard expeditions, but the player will always have the opportunity to read the texts in the report. We understand that not everyone is a fast reader (especially in a foreign language), but we don’t want to stop the pace of the standard Expedition. We believe that flavour texts will blend in the waiting periods when the player waits for expedition result or for the next random quest.
However, the career expeditions will stop the timer during the events. Player will have unlimited time to decide what to do. Keep in mind that those ‘flavour texts’ are more complex, will have voice over and will require a choice from the player.

[b]How many career expeditions will there be in the career mode?[/b]
There will be a few. Not as many as random events, the career expeditions are also limited by the plot and each one of them needs to have its place in the whole story.

[b]What about the conflict between flavour texts and random event (event in the mail after expeditions)?[/b]
There won’t be such a thing as a conflict between those. We’ve solved this problem, the random events are going to adapt the event in the flavour texts and we are happy to inform you that there shouldn’t be any contradictions.

[b]Could the story be altered by the player choices on the career expeditions?[/b]
We really would love to create such a system in the future, but for now, it’s not possible for Archeo: Shinar. The choices during the career expeditions will affect only the gameplay on those expeditions.

[b]When there will be the next update?[/b]
We are currently working on the career mode and we can’t give you a date (like we used to with last updates), because we are testing a lot of scenarios. We plan to release a new update in May, but the date isn’t clear yet. 

[b]Will there be new audio tracks for the career expeditions?[/b]
No, we don’t want to add more music to the game. We have 2 more audio tracks but we keep them for something else. The career expeditions should have a few sound effects which aren’t in the current version of the game and will appear only on those expeditions.

[b]Could you tell us when the game will be released (full version)?[/b]
No, we can’t do that. We have in-house deadlines and schedules and we can estimate when the game will be ready, but there are a few variables (like voice actors) which can affect the schedules. We wouldn’t feel comfortable giving you the release date, but we are doing our best to stay in the early access no more than 6 months.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update #03 Note
notes.content:
[b]Update #03 Note[/b]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/3a4ca94e7470de7f4aa89385c8d9e3dd62866b22.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/64dbd03ee47eb733c1300980e2fbe0af03b7e635.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Changes[/b]
[b]1.Press Rework[/b]
[i]Commentary: New way to spend exclusive license with guarantee effect, relations reports, Chess Club, new interface and more. We encourage you to learn more in Archeopedia or in the new tutorial.[/i]
[b]2. Demand on the Black Market - Notification[/b]
[i]Commentary: A notification when the player tries to click on demand when there’s no demanded artifact in the warehouse.[/i]
[b]3. Archeopedia adjustments[/b]
[i]Commentary: With new features Archeopedia needs adjustments. We added there everything about expedition reports, forecasts, new gazettes and so on.[/i]
[b]4. New graphics in opponents’ bios[/b]
[b]5. Detailed Salary Reports[/b]
[i]Commentary: No more raw paychecks. The player will get a detailed report including every explorer and overdue value.[/i]
[b]6. New tutorial (3/5)[/b]
[i]Commentary: We have implemented a brand new tutorial divided into 5 parts. The fifth part isn’t released, because we want to keep it for the full release. To access the second tutorial the player needs to finish the first one. [/i]
[b]7. Gazettes’ favours - option to go back at the stage when the player should select the target[/b]
[i]Commentary: For TAoDJ’s favours player couldn’t go back even if there was a need to check which opponent is a threat.[/i]
[b]8. Generation of Artifacts on expeditions changed[/b]
[i]Commentary: The player won’t find expensive artifacts on easy expeditions, and vice versa, the player won’t find cheap artifacts on very difficult expeditions.[/i]
[b]9. Ruthless Success - a change in the formula[/b]
[i]Commentary: We wanted to give more credit to explorers’ skills. Overall high skilled explorers are going to find more artifacts.[/i]
[b]10. RAG - Favours profits changed[/b]
[i]Commentary: Sponsoring gives 9 instead of 5 items and for one favour the player can get 1 free item. [/i]
[b]11. Attitude - Information on hover[/b]
[b]12. Local Guide (Booster) - New Icon[/b]
[b]13. Black Market - Demand verification[/b]
[i]Commentary: The 3 cheapest artifacts won’t be demanded anymore. If a player needs money and decides to sell artifacts on demand, the cheapest artifacts won’t save the budget. This way there will be more space on demand for other artifacts.[/i]
[b]14. Black Market - Sales verification[/b]
[i]Commentary: The 6 cheapest artifacts won’t be on sale on Black Market. The reason is that there’s no point to do so. The player just doesn’t need to buy cheap artifacts.[/i]
[b]15. Shady auction man[/b]
[i]Commentary: There’s a shady auction man. Cuppy refers to him in the tutorial, but it’s also an indicator for the player, which shows if the player has already bid in this round.[/i]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[b]1.Merchant Company - Stimulants’ counters fixed[/b]

[b]Old save files won’t work with the new update![/b]

[b]What about the flavour text on the Expeditions?[/b]
The texts were implemented and tested, but the feature isn’t working as intended. We need to adjust it because for now, it’s just a bunch of silly comments on expeditions. We’re going to make it more immersive, divide them according to the location of an expedition and we want third flavour text on every expedition to be something more. For now, the flavour texts could get contradictory with random events, we cannot allow such a thing to happen. The feature needs more love and attention, and we are willing to spend more time on it because we feel that in its current state it’s not adding anything to the game.

[b]What’s new about the career mode?[/b]
We’ve been working on it in the meantime, the basic mechanics for mission’s goals are ready. We are testing the feature allowing to save explorers for the next mission. We still polish the story and we are not happy about the Career Lobby interface. If everything goes well, we will be able to determine the release date.

[b]Why there’s no tutorial 4 and 5?[/b]
The 5th tutorial (Tactics) will be released with the career mode. The content of this tutorial should be hidden from new players because it could affect the experience. It will be accessible after 4th career mission. The 4th tutorial (Shady Operations) was tested before this update (with all the others), and… it’s confusing for new players. Unlike the 5th tutorial, we don’t need to hide it from new players, but we need to improve it. It should be clear for some that ‘Shady Operations’ means the Black Market, and with the 4th tutorial we want not only to show to you that this part of the game exists, but also teach you how to use it in your strategy. However, the Black Market play depends on a lot of variables, like if the player owns a museum, does the player has enough money for the next salary or does the player know the value of an artifact on sale. Our attempt to show this delicate subject in this tutorial caused only confusion. We decided to cut it out and rework it once again. Probably we will reduce the 4th tutorial and place the extra information in the 5th tutorial or in Archeopedia. Our end goal is to create a smooth learning curve, where the player gets one tutorial after each career mission. This way we can prevent the player from failure due to the lack of knowledge about gameplay rules, but also we don’t need to push everything at once. And the implication of this is that the first missions in the career mode will be easy for the early access players, but they will be able to use their knowledge of the game to complete those missions faster.

[b]More about Localization -> [/b]https://steamcommunity.com/games/1001980/announcements/detail/1734356745767904572

[b]More about Voice Over -> [/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1001980/announcements/detail/1813169105641848799

[b]Summary[/b]
	With update #03 we wanted to finish the gameplay. In the future, we don’t want to change it (like we did with the press), but we are going to monitor the balance and intervene if there’s something bad happening. The game even after the full release will get our support for at least 6 months, and if any problems or bugs occurs we will fix them.
    Meanwhile, we are working on career mode. To deliver you a decent story, interesting gameplay and maybe something more we need some time, but it is not going to be years. If you are waiting for the full release we are sure it’s the matter of months now. In the Early Access note, we stated that the full release will be after 3 to 6 months after the early access release, and we are working around the clock to keep this promise.


Cheers!

notes.title: The Localization - What about that?
notes.content:
[h1]The Localization - What about that?[/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/c3674f477b7bc8ea97e20f91f3f5460aac97477c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/70d6c84769102a9786b046bb534cb8f59cbedce1.jpg[/img][/url]

At this moment we are not going to localize Archeo: Shinar, when the game is in Early Access. We are preparing structures which will make localization (not dubbing!) possible and easy to implement, but in the current state we decided to work on the Career mode, voice over and the interface. For some, it may be not clear, but we will support Archeo even after the full release for at least 6 months. We hope that after the release we will earn money for the localization, which is always a great addition for non-English speakers. However, we not only need more budget to work on localization but also we don’t want to limit the languages based on our sales data, which clearly states that we should deliver only a few localizations.

What’s more, a lot of people reached us offering their service and help with the localization. That’s great, we really appreciate your passion and your attitude. You are awesome, wonderful people! And we probably will reach you back and use your help, however, we can not imagine doing so without rewarding each person. When we are talking about the lack of budget for the localization, we hope that a significant fraction of it will be spent to reward your hard work and magnificent attitude!

We should also add that most of you usually don’t see the amount of text in the game. We tried to limit it for your experience, but Archeo has a lot of ‘forks’ which hides the alternative events and so on. We can tell you that random events on their own have more than 35 000 words. As a comparison, a standard book (200 pages of manuscript) has about 55 000 words. At this point, we can’t even estimate how many words Archeo will have, because we are still writing the career mode. We just can’t expect anyone to translate our game for free.

To sum it up, we are going to release a full game with the career mode only in English. The game will be prepared for further localization, which we hope to deliver in the next few months after the release. 

Cheers!

notes.title: How many Random Events are in Archeo: Shinar?
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/4ad0248bd1e188a2fccce32399e8a5f7ef1b180d.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/a4e18b62405a51ea1070729f20aafe58ca98c219.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]How many Random Events are in Archeo: Shinar?[/h1]

We've been asked about it a few times now.
Archeo: Shinar contains 98 random events, but we should make something clear about those.
8 of them are special events related to legendary explorers.
30 of them are simple events, which have their own conditions and will fill the blank spots if there's no place for advanced one (for example because of too big impact on the gameplay).
And we have also 60 advanced ones. Each advanced random event has its own storyline, it has always a meaningful choice and appears more than once in a game. Advanced random events are like simple stories always with two different sequels, but the player gets only one of them due to his choices. We can say that the whole 60 advanced random events contain more than 180 simple random events linked together.
There's no limit on how much advanced random events the player can get during his (or her) one custom game, but usually, it won't be more than 10.
The same event can't occur twice in the same run, but can during two different runs. In the career mode, random events can't occur twice in two consecutive runs.
If you want to know more, we posted a thread on the community hub about random events some time ago.

Cheers!

notes.title: The Tutorial - What will it be alike?
notes.content:
[h1]The Tutorial - What will it be alike?[/h1]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/c3674f477b7bc8ea97e20f91f3f5460aac97477c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/70d6c84769102a9786b046bb534cb8f59cbedce1.jpg[/img][/url]

Current tutorial isn’t going to be in the final version. We want to deliver you tutorial divided into 5 lessons. Each lesson is going to be shorter than the current tutorial. But what’s more interesting, you will have the opportunity to experience it with the next update (04.04.2019). Each lesson will help you with something else. Of course, the first one must tell the player about expeditions and explorers (and character creator, we definitely can’t leave you alone with such a difficult task alone), but every other will bring new mechanics, like Press or Property Management.

However, each tutorial will be locked (we’re going to unlock 4 out of 5 in the period between next update and full release) due to career progress. After the next milestones in the career player will unlock new tutorials. This way a new player won’t have to learn everything at once and the process of learning won’t be too demanding.

The fifth lesson is going to be locked until the full release. This certain tutorial will introduce the player to more advanced tactics. We are locking it because playing Archeo with that knowledge might impact the first experience and it’s not meant to learn that before the first play. We even assume that player during the career will learn all the tactics presented in tutorial 5 and it won’t change the experience for him (or her). 

What’s more about the tutorial? Like always, there will be Cuppy to guide you. And she will have a voice! All 5 tutorials are going to have voice over for Cuppy and her babbling. We wanted to deliver the voice over quicker, but it would be more expensive to divide work for voice actor into a few gigs when we can take care of it when all the tutorials are in place. (There’s also a little chance that we would also use Cuppy in the career and we need her voice there, but we didn’t tell you anything about it.)

Cheers!

notes.title: Roadmap - Update #03
notes.content:
[h1]Roadmap - Update #03[/h1]
[b]Planned release date of Update #03: 04.04.2019[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34132006/64dbd03ee47eb733c1300980e2fbe0af03b7e635.jpg[/img]

[b]1.Press Rework[/b]
[i]Commentary: We want to introduce Royal Chess Club with 3 chief editors from the gazettes. The player is going to have two actions per round with gazettes, one in the chess club and one in the press tab. There will be also a way to learn more about the player’s current relationship with gazettes and brand new way to share the story everywhere to build up the player’s popularity.[/i]
[b]2. Flavour text on expeditions[/b]
[i]Commentary: On every expedition, there will be 3 hidden messages about events during the voyage. It won’t affect gameplay.[/i]
[b]3. Archeopedia adjustments[/b]
[i]Commentary: With new features Archeopedia needs adjustments. We want to add there everything about expedition reports, forecasts and land auction schedule.[/i]
[b]4. User Interface adjustments[/b]
[i]Commentary: We can start now final work on the UI because we won’t add more features to the gameplay. And Archeo needs a lot of work on the UI. We want more text bubbles on hover with more information about the components. Graphic indicators for some actions (Have I bid for land in this round?) and more.[/i]
[b]5. Detailed Salary Reports[/b]
[i]Commentary: We have expedition reports, we are going to have press relation reports, but what’s about the costs? Yes, we are going to add this too. No more raw paychecks.[/i]
[b]6. Bug fixes[/b]
[i]Commentary: Like always in early access.[/i]
[b]7. The new tutorial[/b]
[i]Commentary: The new tutorial is going to be divided into 5 lessons. It’s a huge change for Archeo. For now, we will grant you access to 4 out of 5 lessons. In the final release, the player will have access only to the first one, and the rest of the tutorials will be unlocked during career. This way player will learn how to play the game step by step and it won’t be necessary to remember everything at once. Lessons are going to be shorter than the current tutorial but focused on delivering you more information and tactical insight. The game won’t lock features in the career mode just because they were not mentioned in the tutorial, but some of them will be introduced later in the game. We are going to add voice over to the tutorial but it probably won’t be there with the next update.[/i]

[h1]Meantime[/h1]

We are working on the Career mode and we will tell you more about it in the nearest future. We encourage you to share your opinions and ideas in the comments and to be active!

[h1]Summary[/h1]

With the Update #03 we want to finish the gameplay (which means we won’t add new features to the gameplay, but it’s not like the game is 100% balanced yet) and start to polish the interface and focus on the story (career mode). We understand that Archeo needs a clear and easy way to teach new players how to play and without a good tutorial, it feels like a bunch of strange features and odd rules. Nevertheless, we encourage you to experiment with Archeo, and if you don't want to get confused, you can always wait a little bit, because Cuppy will tell you everything you need to know soon.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update #02 Note
notes.content:
[h1]Update #02 Note[/h1]


[h1]Changes[/h1]
[b]1.Expedition Forecast[/b]
[i]Commentary: Basically player has 3 expeditions to choose from. It’s possible to have more choices due to the train station or other factors (random events). The forecast will deliver information about one out of three basic expeditions in advance. Depending on the difficulty the range of forecast may vary.[/i]
2.Prices Charts
[i]Commentary: Prices charts for stimulants, because the player needs to know when the Merchant Company is robbing him and Prices charts for the land market because the player needs to know how much has he (or the bot) overpaid.[/i]
3.Merchant Company Boosters 
[i]Commentary: There will always be 3 boosters to choose from, and the merchant company will try to personalize one of the boosters for the player and his needs.[/i]
4.Black Market - The risk of buying Artifacts 
[i]Commentary: In a nutshell, it won’t be that risky like it is now. Also, all of the cheap Artifacts won’t appear on Black Market’s sales.[/i]
5.Black Market - Demand rework
[i]Commentary: We want to give every artifact at least one chance to appear on demand. Also, we don’t want cheap artifacts on the demand.[/i]
[b]6.Generating first 5 explorers and their addictions[/b]
[i]Commentary: To balance the starting condition we want to create situation 2-2-1, which means that on start there will be always 2 explorers addicted to stimulant_1, 2 explorers addicted to stimulant_2 and 1 addicted to stimulant_3. And by 'addicted' we mean that they are very enthusiastic about certain stimulant.[/i]
7.Property Management - Interaction with the map
[i]Commentary: Clicking on nobody’s lands or on lands of your opponent will open the brief note about the land.[/i]
[b]8.Schedule of land auctions[/b]
Commentary: The auctions will be prepared in advance and the player will [i]have the opportunity to plan next moves depending on the quality of the lands and their potential value. The auctions will be executed the same as in the current version, but the schedule will let you consider saving money for the next round.[/i]
[b]9.Expedition Reports[/b]
[i]Commentary: Reports contain all the information about the last expedition. The player can access all reports from the current game in the lobby. It’s super important because the information about the chance of success will be there (and it probably will be 100% or 0%, because Archeo gives % chances only for a certain range of lacking skill, and for Quests with “+” there’s no rng at all). With this tool, the player can learn quicker and better how to evaluate the difficulty of expeditions.[/i]
10. Background for items in Warehouse changed
11. Credits updated
12. Information for attempting to put artifact on the Black Market without accepting risk and margin.
13. AI opponents’ aggression on the land market decreased
[i]Commentary: Bots are aggressive on the land market, and they should be to prevent the player from buying too many lands. But they were too aggressive because they know that they can’t bankrupt. It should be better now, at least after the first 10 rounds, when we feel they should be aggressive.[/i]
14. New information for each land - when and for how much was it bought
[i]Commentary: With Interaction with the map you can see this information for every land on the map.[/i]
[b]15. Getting Fears on Normal Difficulty changed[/b]
[i]Commentary: We feel that our last attempt didn’t solve this problem for the Normal difficulty. We decided to place a brand new algorithm for this difficulty, which allows 100% security if the right stimulant is present. The only negative factor (which means it’s the only reason for getting a fear) is now the lack of the certain stimulant (based on explorer’s addiction)[/i]
16. Cautious Attitude gives a better bonus to the risk of getting a fear.
[b]17. Lands’ statistics are presented by bars instead of raw numbers[/b]
[i]Commentary: It’s important to see the max. limit od land’s statistics. The player needs to know that a certain value is high or low. With bars, it should be clear.[/i]
18. A few adjustments for the random events in the code
19. “Thumb” graphic in the expedition
20. Archeopedia - text correction
[b]21. Changes in random quests on the expedition - RNG factor terminated[/b]
[i]Commentary: We’ve changed the formula for the random quests. Player probably won’t even see the differences but there are a few. First of all, we’ve terminated raw RNG factor. It was a small value, but after a lot of feedback, we decided to terminate it. After that, we had a void in the formula, and we needed to add a new factor to fill it for the balance. We added new relation for the amount of explorer participating in the random quest with the rule “the more the merrier”.[/i]
22.  Cautious Attitude buffed
Commentary: After changes to getting fears on Normal Difficulty, cautious attitude became useless. We decided to buff it to make it a tool for players, who want to save some money on the stimulants but also don’t want to risk too many fears. Nevertheless, cautious attitude always will be a better tool on harder difficulties.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
1. The sailor path in animation in the Quarters fixed
2. [ESC] works for Archeopedia
[b]3. The game starts on the best possible resolution for the player’s PC[/b]
[b]4. The fired explorers’ salary fixed[/b]
[i]Commentary: It was a game breaking bug, and we are glad it’s solved now.[/i]
[b]5. The bug with land auction report fixed[/b]
[i]Commentary: Sometimes it showed the wrong winner. [/i]
6. Random Event ‘Need more coffee” fixed

[h1]Summary[/h1]
This update provides adjustments to the gameplay and should help a lot with the understanding of the game. We didn’t want players to spend their time in the archeopedia learning basic and trying to figure it out. Instead, we want the player to learn on his mistakes and gather more and more experience with every other expedition. That’s why we added more tools for predictions and reports.

During our work on Update #02, we also had time to work on the career mode. At this time we know exactly what we can add to the game and what we will add in the next updates. 

In next days we’re going to talk with you, the community, about our plans for next updates, for the release and about the career mode. We would love to see your activity and opinions and we hope that our plans and your expectations will meet.


Cheers!

notes.title: Update #01 Note
notes.content:
[h1]Update #01 Note[/h1]


[h1]Changes[/h1]
1. Three new preparation tracks and remasters of the rest of preparation tracks.
[i]Commentary: The soundtrack is finished. The game still needs more sound effects, but we do not plan to add more music.[/i]
[b]2. Difficulty Description changes[/b]
Easy -> Normal
Normal -> Hard
Hard -> Dreadful
[i]Commentary: Due to overwhelming feedback from the community we decided to change the difficulty description. It seems like playing on "old" normal was a challenge for everyone, and "old" hard was a nightmare. It's clear now.[/i]
3. Font size in the tutorial was changed to bigger
4. Information about career mode
[i]Commentary: A lot of players wonder why the career isn't available. Now there is a temporary message to make it clear.[/i]
5. Cuppy, if necessary, will talk less. 
[i]Commentary: Cuppy's commentary was more like a chore to hide than a pleasure. We decided to make it less frequent.[/i]
[b]6. Option to turn off the Cuppy Commentary[/b]
7. Expeditions in round 1 won't require more than 7 explorers, and in round 2 it won't be more 
than 8.
[i]Commentary: It's impossible to hire more than 7 explorers in round 1. We feel that hiring 9 explorers in round 2 is a bad move and we don't want to encourage new players to do so. There always was at least one expedition for less than 7 explorers, but we do not want players to suffer because some expeditions are beyond their reach.[/i]
8. After clicking the button to return to the menu the game will ask confirmation.
[i]Commentary: We don't want players to exit the game by mistake.[/i]
9. After clicking on an explorer to set a new manager for a building the game will ask for confirmation.
[i]Commentary: We don't want players to set managers by accident.[/i]
10. Georadar description changes
[i]Commentary: We heard voices that georadar shouldn't be in the game. We disclaimed that georadar is in right place, but we change its description to better introduce it to the players.[/i]
11. Flintlock changed to Revolver
[i]Commentary: We wanted to place a outdated weapon for +3 CC Booster. However, to show you more consistent world we decided to change flintlock to still outdated model of revolver.[/i]
12. The "calendar" during the expeditions is placed a little bit higher
[b]13. Attitude values changed[/b]
[i]Commentary: We wanted to give Attitude more recognition. The bonuses from the attitude are bigger now and we decided for Precarious Attitude to give constant value instead random range.[/i]
14. Font size in Cuppy commentary is bigger now
15. Confiscating Artifacts cost less reputation if the player wants to recover the artifact.
[i]Commentary: The decision to lose artifact and 1 point of reputation or 3 points of reputation wasn't really a choice. Now it changes to artifact and 1 reputation or 2 reputations. Depends on the artifact it may be better now to keep the artifact instead.[/i]
[b]16. Super Easy Opponent on Normal[/b]
[i]Commentary: The game is hard for casual players and we want them to feel better after not going bankrupt. By normal we mean new normal (old easy). This opponent has decreased reputation gained in his expeditions. We don't want to make casual player sad by giving him the last place on the summary even on the easiest difficulty. Super Easy Opponent won't appear on other difficulties.[/i]
[b]17. Gazettes - Rework[/b]
[i]Commentary: Gazettes needed rework and we are not done with them. We've added a new stage of relations and a new stage of interest. The relations will take credit of actions even 3 round ago, the gifts will always have an impact (even if it's a wrong one) in the current round, the right gifts will have more impact and the relations will have even more meaning. Our goal is to despite story value give a chance for the player to get 100% chances of getting favours. In nutshell, if the player keeps great relations with a certain gazette, the favours will be granted for sure.[/i]
18. Buying a new building - The price next to the Buy button
19. The overall potential revenues from land considered in bots biddings
[i]Commentary: AI opponents will bid less in further rounds because there is less time to get back the value from the lands. Before that bots statistically bid too high after 12 round.[/i]
20. Stimulants are stronger on Normal Difficulty
[i]Commentary: To avoid fears game requires stimulants and Attitude Cautious. We decided to give some slack to the easiest difficulty (old Easy) and stimulants are enough to ensure you that there won't be any problems. It means that Cautious Attitude is pointless on Normal, but makes the game better for the casual player. In the future with better tools to introduce mechanics in career mode we might go back, however, for now, it's better this way.[/i]
21. Archeopedia - Detailed Description about Random Quests
[i]Commentary: There's just too much misinformation going on and we see that players are struggling with understanding how it works. Now there's a place in the game where you can read more about it.[/i]
[b]22. Tutorial changes[/b]
[i]Commentary: First of all, we set more free space in the character creation process. It's a simple action and everybody knows how to do it. We also decided to make the golden team constant statistics and Cuppy will tell more about Random Quest on expeditions. We cut some text just to not making it longer, but the humorous vibe is still there.[/i]
23. Three new outfits for female character (player)
[i]Commentary: We heard voices demanding more outfits for the female character. [/i]
24. Four new achievements
[i]Commentary: We wanted to add some easier achievements to reward all the players, even for failures.[/i]
[b]25. Expedition Quest 1 & 5 - Skills+ and Guaranteed required skill[/b]
[i]Commentary: We’ve seen that a lot of players are confused by this. We added “+” to the skill name in random quest 1 and random quest 5 to inform you better, that those quests are harder than the common ones. There’s no randomness in those quests, in the quest with + the game checks if you have enough efficiency and if not, then it’s a failure. Also, we decided to change random quest 5 the quest with +. What’s more interesting, those quests are always defined by required skills from expedition description. The reason behind no information about it in the first place, was to introduce it after first career mission, but we see that we cannot wait with this any second longer. Now it should be clear, or at least understandable to the new players.[/i]
[b]26. The change of the font[/b]
[i]Commentary: We hear you, now it should be easier for the eyes to read texts.[/i]
27. Back button 15% bigger
28. Hover over back button shows [Esc] information
[i]Commentary: We never intended to make you click this tiny button with your mouse. There was always a function under [esc] button on the keyboard, but only a small fraction of the playerbase tried to push the escape. It should be clear now. And we made the button bigger if you still want to click it with the mouse.[/i]
[b]29. Report from the land auction[/b]
[i]Commentary: Now you get the information about bids on the land market. We want to go in this direction with everything in Archeo, to give player more reports on everything going on behind the scenes. And we feel that it’s a wonderful change for local multiplayer when you can see bids of your opponents in your turn when it’s not recommended to sneak peek when they are bidding. We feel your urge to sneak peek, but if you know that you will no matter what see it later, this urge shouldn’t be that strong.[/i]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]1. Infinity training people when the player doesn't have money fixed.[/b]
2. Setting music volume to 0 fixed.
[b]3. Resolution 3440x1440 support fixed.[/b]
[i]Commentary: It's playable now. We want it to look better in the future.[/i]
4. Hot Seat character creation "now it's your turn" information fixed.
5. Archeopedia and Bidding on Artifact screen fixed.
[b]6. Congratulatory Letter bug fixed. [/b]
7. Spellings fixed.
[i]Commentary: At least the big ones like Linquistics.[/i]

[h1]Summary[/h1]
We wanted to show to our growing community that we care about our game and about players’ opinion. We are working on Career mode in the background and we have in plans a few adjustments to the gameplay, but with this update, we hope you will feel more secure about Archeo’s future. We focused on fixing bugs and little changes as a response to your opinions. In the next updates, we want to add more to the game, but we know that adding new content and features before fixing the old ones doesn’t look promising to you. Next update will be there in 4 to 6 weeks from now, but we’re going to inform you more about it and probably talk about new features on the community hub.

Cheers!
